## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, `--help` text) where behaviour changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under "Unreleased"
- [ ] Contract changes (`crates/contract`, `contract/v1`) are additive, or a new version is proposed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, private keys or real personal data in the diff, fixtures or logs
- [ ] No new dependency, or the new dependency is justified below
